expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: In the bottom tab bar, the 'Orders' tab has only a text label with no icon above it, while Home, Search and Profile all have icons. This makes the label sit lower/misaligned relative to the other tabs and breaks visual rhythm.

The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the Tokumaru Ramen card has a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below has a dark/transparent circle with a white heart, which reduces contrast and consistency.

The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a light gray gradient background that looks like a placeholder, contrasting sharply with the dark, photographic-looking thumbnails of the adjacent cards.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the Orders tab in the bottom nav bar lacking an icon, which is the missing icon defect, though it notes text misalignment as a secondary effect.
